name: Six Years On
source:
A Fire Emblem: Three Houses visual novel about small events in Edelgard and F!Byleth's relationship over the years.

[From [url=https://the4thsnake.itch.io/six-years-on]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部《火焰之纹章：风花雪月》同人视觉小说，描绘了艾黛尔贾特与贝雷丝在岁月流转间相知相守的点滴日常。

[摘自[url=https://the4thsnake.itch.io/six-years-on]itch.io[/url]]
